questions_and_answers.question_text: Warum geht Herr Köhler zum Generalkonsulat?

answers.answer_text: He wants to apply for a visa.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wohin will er fahren?

answers.answer_text: He wants to go to America.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wen trifft er im Konsulat?

answers.answer_text: He meets an acquaintance, Mr. Allen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wo arbeitet Herr Jones?

answers.answer_text: He works in the visa section.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Warum muss Herr Köhler nach Amerika fahren?

answers.answer_text: He has to make a business trip.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wie lange will er dort bleiben?

answers.answer_text: He wants to stay about four to six weeks.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ist Herr Köhler Deutscher?

answers.answer_text: Yes, he is a German citizen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Was muss Herr Köhler ausfüllen?

answers.answer_text: He must fill out a form.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wie gefällt es Herrn Allen in Bremen?

answers.answer_text: He likes it very much in Bremen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Warum gefällt es seiner Frau dort nicht so gut?

answers.answer_text: Because his wife can't get used to the climate.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wo möchte sie lieber wohnen?

answers.answer_text: She would rather live in Bavaria.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ist Bremen die Heimatstadt von Herrn Köhler?

answers.answer_text: No, his hometown is Berlin.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Welches Bier trinkt Herr Allen gern?

answers.answer_text: He likes to drink Pilsner.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Welches Bier trinkt Herr Köhler lieber?

answers.answer_text: He prefers Würzburger.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Warum trinkt Herr Allen nicht Löwenbräu?

answers.answer_text: Because there's no Löwenbräu in this restaurant.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Was raucht Herr Köhler?

answers.answer_text: He smokes a pipe.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Warum sucht Herr Köhler ein Zigarrengeschäft?

answers.answer_text: Because he has no tobacco left.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wo ist ein Zigarrengeschäft?

answers.answer_text: There's one next to the restaurant.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Was bietet Herr Allen Herrn Köhler an?

answers.answer_text: He offers him a cigar.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wen soll Herr Köhler besuchen?

answers.answer_text: He is supposed to visit the Allens.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wo wohnen Allens?

answers.answer_text: They live in a new building.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Warum passt es Herrn Köhler am Sonntag nicht?

answers.answer_text: He already has an appointment on Sunday.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Passt es ihm am Montag besser?

answers.answer_text: No, Saturday is more convenient for him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Um wieviel Uhr soll er kommen?

answers.answer_text: He is supposed to come at four o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In welcher Straße wohnen Allens?

answers.answer_text: They live on Schiller Street.
